# Running pace & splits

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/running-pace/

Calculate pace, speed and equal-distance race splits. This browser tool shows the inputs, assumptions and resulting output so you can use it for a specific everyday task.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Convert a 5 km run completed in 30 minutes into pace per kilometer and a split table.

## Limits and checks

Splits assume constant pace on the entered distance. Terrain, weather and individual performance are not predicted.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
